definitions.explanation: The act of creating or establishing something new, such as an institution, facility, department, or system. Also used as a modifier to describe something newly created.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{学部|がくぶ}を{新設|しんせつ}する。
{駅前|えきまえ}に{保育園|ほいくえん}が{新設|しんせつ}された。
examples.english: A nursery school was newly established in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{災害|さいがい}{対策|たいさく}のための{新設|しんせつ}{機関|きかん}を{来年|らいねん}{発足|ほっそく}させる{方針|ほうしん}だ。
examples.english: The government plans to launch a newly established agency for disaster response next year.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb ({新設|しんせつ}する) or as a noun modifier ({新設|しんせつ}の). The homophone {親切|しんせつ} (kindness) is a completely different word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学校|がっこう}を{新設|しんせつ}する: to newly establish a school
- {新設|しんせつ}{部門|ぶもん}: newly created department
- {新設|しんせつ}{校|こう}: newly built school
- {新設|しんせつ}{合併|がっぺい}: new merger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {設立|せつりつ}: establishment, founding (more general)
- {創設|そうせつ}: founding, creation (emphasizes being the first)
